source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Requester authorizes independent randomized complex photographic concepts and reference-image generation for actual color-keyword fidelity testing. Coordinator lane labels are experimental choices, not requester definitions. Independently interpret Split Complementary as a dominant hue with two neighbors of its opposite, Color Echo as separated repeated chromatic accents, and Color Framing as colored peripheral structures visibly enclosing the subject.
subject: Reference-appearance mountain weather observer
setting: Remote mountain observatory stone doorway after a storm
event: Observer steadies a water-filled graduated rain cylinder with its detached funnel held beside it
visual_priorities: Legible measuring action and reference appearance
Three spatial color relationships readable in a layered environmental portrait
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photographic editorial of a mountain weather observer measuring a brass rain gauge at a remote observatory after a passing storm. Use the attached portrait as the appearance reference for her facial structure, dark eyes, and long wavy dark hair. She stands on the broad dry stone threshold, both boots planted apart; her left hand steadies the upright graduated cylinder on a waist-high stone ledge while her right hand holds its detached brass funnel beside it. The cylinder base rests flat on the ledge and a clear water meniscus catches the light. Her face and both hands remain visible in a three-quarter view. Beyond her, mist separates pine-covered slopes and a small observatory roof. A dominant deep blue field formed by the observatory doorway and storm clouds is balanced by separate yellow-orange and red-orange accents in a split complementary color relationship. A yellow-orange woven scarf is echoed by a small yellow-orange enamel gauge marker and a distant yellow-orange roof panel, linking foreground, subject, and background through color echo. Deep blue painted doorway uprights occupy the left and right image margins, forming color framing around the observer and her warm scarf. Let the brass show damp engraved texture, the hair remain softly wind-tossed, and the face retain natural skin detail. Compose a coherent environmental portrait with legible weather-measuring action and layered mountain depth.
